To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have developed an automatic tool that identifies relations between objects, which we call concepts.
we have developed an approach which is able to identify and display relations between tables in the NAV application, and that the REA ontology can be used in the analysis, but with some limitations.
it is possible, using a pattern recognition approach, to extract and display relations in the application code, and that the REA ontology can be identified in the application code.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how the NAV application code can be abstracted to a graphical representation of the concepts it contains.
how to extract knowledge of relations between tables in the NAV application, and to present this knowledge in a graphical form.
the analysis of C/AL code and the extraction of concepts.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
it is possible, with our approach and tools to identify and display concepts in the NAV application.
it is possible, with our approach, to identify the concepts of containment, aggregation, generalization, and events in NAV application code.
the NAV organization can benefit from our work.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
it is possible for us to analyze C/AL code, identify concepts, and present them graphically.
we can identify and present the relations between objects, which are defined in the application code.
we have shown that it is possible with pattern matching and refactoring to identify concepts and relations in a C/AL code base.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we have developed a good tool for the NAV organization to use in order to get a good overview of their application code.
it is possible, by pattern matching and code refactoring, to abstract the code specific concepts to an understandable representation.
it is possible, by using the pattern matching approach, to extract concepts from the NAV application code which are of value for the NAV organization in the process of refactoring.
